title: 條
teacherNotes: Production A complete-package handoff for L302 條. Use approved sentences exactly. Latest origin/main is complete through L300 爬 with review modules through R016, so this is a lesson-local package blocked until R017/R018 and L301 蟲 are in main. Learner-facing allowed-character sweep covers text, spokenText, displayLines, focusChar, and Stage 4 option text. Image notes and prompts are production instructions and are not part of the learned-character gate. Keep insect imagery cute, gentle, sparse, and preschool-appropriate; no gross close-ups, horror, dense swarms, text, numbers, labels, or watermarks.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: latest origin/main learned chars through production JSON L300 + provisional learned chars [蟲] + current new char 條
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family continuity from docs/LESSON_VISUAL_CAST_SOP.md and docs/CURRICULUM_LEDGER.md.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No visible text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, signs, labels, logos, brands, subtitles, readable marks, or watermarks anywhere.
Insects must be cute, gentle, sparse, and preschool-appropriate; no gross close-ups, horror, dense swarms, or realistic frightening details.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 條 as public/assets/lessons/L302/audio/char-u689d.m4a from the single character.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 一條小河從草地或山邊流向遠方的大海，畫面開闊、明亮。重點是小河像一條線流進大海；不可有文字、數字、標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 一條小蟲爬到頭上，我嚇一跳。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 一條小蟲爬到頭上我嚇一跳
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 一條可愛小蟲爬到主角小女孩頭上，主角小女孩嚇一跳但不是嚴重驚恐，主角媽媽可在旁邊安撫。畫面要清楚呈現小蟲在頭上、嚇一跳；不可有恐怖感、文字、數字、標籤。
家裡的小狗爬上床，主角媽媽站在床邊嚴肅提醒不可以這樣，主角小女孩在旁邊看著。畫面要清楚呈現小狗爬上床、被媽媽罵；不可有文字、數字、標籤。
主角小女孩和主角爸爸站在路口或分岔小路前，主角小女孩指著其中一條路，像是在問走這條路對不對。畫面要清楚呈現選路與問路情境；不可有路牌文字、數字、標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 小鳥看見一條蟲，就飛過去。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 小鳥看見一條蟲就飛過去
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 一隻小鳥看見地上或樹葉上的一條小蟲，正朝小蟲飛過去。畫面要清楚呈現小鳥看見一條蟲後飛過去；不要畫吃掉的瞬間，不要血腥或驚嚇，不可有文字、數字、標籤。
